title: Monoidal derived inflation and graded cup composition
statement:
Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring on the small coherent profinite site and $G$ a profinite group, in the universes and internal module/action categories of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-weil-size-convention]. Use ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and internal derived tensor over $A$. Trivial inflation induces an exact strong symmetric monoidal functor
$$L:D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)\longrightarrow D(\mathcal A_G(A)),$$
with $L(A[0])=A[0]$, and a canonical derived adjunction $L\dashv R\Gamma_G$. The derived adjunction is the one obtained from the invariant inclusion and equivariant injective resolutions, namely the canonical derived adjunction of [lem-sfb-condensed-derived-restriction-calculus], whose underived inflation/invariants adjunction is that of [lem-sfb-condensed-product-action-inflation] with the second group trivial. The tensor and unit comparisons are induced by the identity on ordinary coefficient tensors and the unit; the shift comparisons use the usual shifted cochain complexes.

Give $C=R\Gamma_G(A[0])$ its canonical unital derived cup product, namely the lax monoidal structure adjoint to the inverse strong monoidal structure of $L$, followed by the unit multiplication $A\otimes_A^L A\cong A$. Let $\Phi_q:\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\mathcal A_G(A))}(A,A[q])\to\operatorname{Hom}_{D(\operatorname{Mod}_A)}(A[-q],C)$ be the shifted adjunction bijection. It sends the identity of $A$ to the cup unit. For $x:A\to A[p]$ and $y:A\to A[q]$, the adjoint of $\Phi_p(x)\smile\Phi_q(y)$ is the tensor of the two arrows, using the fixed tensor/shift comparisons. Equivalently, there are signs $t_{p,q}\in\{1,-1\}$ depending only on $p,q$ and those comparisons such that
$$\Phi_p(x)\smile\Phi_q(y)=t_{p,q}\,\Phi_{p+q}\bigl(y[p]\circ x\bigr).$$
The signs are independent of $A,G,x,y$ and equal $1$ when $p=0$ or $q=0$. The order of this formula is part of the assertion. It holds for all $p,q\geq0$, including the zero ring and the trivial group.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-derived-inflation-monoidal-normalization] to the stated $A,G$. This gives $L$, its signed symmetric strong monoidal structure and usual shifts, and precisely the invariant-inclusion derived adjunction required in the statement. It also presents the action category as modules on a small ringed action site and identifies inflation of the shifted-unit comparisons with those there.

proof.text: Apply [lem-sfb-shifted-cup-adjunction-transpose] to these two derived categories and this adjunction. Both functors are additive; the preceding normalization gives its fixed shifts and its compatibility with $r_{p,q}$. Its lax product followed by unit multiplication is exactly the stipulated cup product. Thus it is unital with $\Phi_0(1)$ its unit, and the transpose of $\Phi_p(x)\smile\Phi_q(y)$ is $m(f\otimes g)r_{p,q}$, where $f=x[-p]$ and $g=y[-q]$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent-formulated internal bar normalization below the direct-image argument; assembly of the three extracted arguments and the original final ordered-composition step

proof.text: On the small ringed action site apply [lem-sfb-shifted-unit-tensor-composition] to the regular unit and these arbitrary derived arrows. Its tensor and shift conventions are the ones supplied by step 1. The transpose is therefore $t_{p,q}g f[-q]\operatorname{can}_{p,q}$, with signs chosen uniformly before $A,G,x,y$, and $t_{p,0}=t_{0,q}=1$.

source.place: Paragraph (3), agent-formulated internal bar normalization below the direct-image argument; assembly of the three extracted arguments and the original final ordered-composition step

proof.text: Shift this last arrow by $p+q$. With the fixed shift-addition identifications, $f[-q][p+q]=x$ and $g[p+q]=y[p]$, so the result is $t_{p,q}y[p]\circ x$. The additive adjunction bijection now gives $\Phi_p(x)\smile\Phi_q(y)=t_{p,q}\Phi_{p+q}(y[p]\circ x)$. The shift and transpose conventions here are those of [lem-sfb-shifted-cup-adjunction-transpose]. No factors are interchanged. Restrict the universal integer signs to $p,q\geq0$. The normalization includes zero degrees. If $A=0$ all arrows vanish and the same signs still work; if $G=1$ the invariant-inclusion adjunction is the identity adjunction by [lem-sfb-derived-inflation-monoidal-normalization].
